primary_interest.quote: We want to replace it with voice agents that handle the first part of the call, then hand off to a human when needed.

use_case.quote: Right now our support line runs on a classic menu-tree IVR.

competitors_voice.quote: we run on Twilio today for the existing IVR. We've also been looking at Sinch

decision_criteria.quote: First, cost predictability. We got burned once, not on voice specifically, but a usage bill came in way higher than forecast

stated_reason.quote: Price overall matters too, per-minute especially, and the total once everything's added up.
